cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Build a Coalition
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Will you join my request to keep the pottery room open late? It looks like a personal favour with one name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Your name would show it's bigger than the evening class.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The morning class wants weekend access.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add that. Could you bring two of them? We'd be several classes asking for better access.
